question: Which brand of automotive antifreeze works best for filling the X200-L?

note: Automotive coolants contain silicates and are not acceptable; use inhibited propylene glycol 30-40% premixed with demineralised water (page 11, Section 3.6).

question: What pressure washer nozzle setting should I use when cleaning the condenser fin pack?
author: independent-U
note: Pressure washers must not be used; wash with water at no more than 3 bar nozzle pressure from the fan side outwards (page 16, task M-04).

question: For E-1002, which two wires should I swap at the compressor terminals to fix the phase rotation?
author: independent-U
note: Swap two incoming phases at the main isolator only, never at the compressor or drive terminals (page 22, Section 7.2; page 25, E-1002).

question: How much water should I spray on the compressor shell to reset the motor protector faster after an E-2001?
author: independent-U
note: The manual forbids cooling the shell with water; it can distort the scroll set and is excluded from warranty. Motor must cool naturally, 45-90 min (page 23, Section 7.5; page 19).

question: The controller only enforces a 60-second off period between compressor starts - can I make it longer?
author: independent-U
note: Minimum off-period is 180 seconds (and minimum run 120 s) (page 13, Section 4.4).

question: Since the filter-drier PN-2208-F only needs replacing every 16,000 hours, can I skip it at the 8,000-hour service?
author: independent-U
note: Filter-drier is replaced every 8,000 operating hours or whenever the circuit is opened (page 15 table M-12, page 17). 16,000 h is the oil acid test interval M-15.
